Subject: Discovery recap + align on technical deep dive and security review

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key notes from discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce per-query inference cost while keeping 95th P90 latency under 150ms for user-facing product.
- Expected volume: 5M token-equivalent requests / month, bursty traffic during business hours.
- Data sensitivity: PII in some fields; retention rules need to meet Acme policy.
- Deployment preference: start hosted, evaluate Dedicated or VPC for production.

Open asks you called out:
1) A short technical deep dive (60 min) with your platform/infra and our SEs to walk throughput/latency tradeoffs.
2) A security checklist for SOC 2 / data handling to review with your compliance team.
3) Preliminary pricing for a 6-month pilot and any procurement steps.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), SOC2-questions.xlsx (initial checklist).

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive where Ben (solutions engineer) will walk architecture and Neha (security) can cover the SOC 2 artifacts. Can you pick one of the slots below (all PST):
- Tue Jun 8, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Jun 8, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Jun 9, 09:00–10:00

If those don't work, share 2 pockets of availability and I will coordinate. I'll also loop in our procurement teammate after we lock the time.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for capturing the asks. Quick notes: 

We can do Tue Jun 8 at 14:00–15:00 PST. That works for our platform lead and me.

A few requests ahead of the deep dive:
- Can Ben provide a short infra diagram (network/VPC, data flow, encryption at rest/in transit)?
- Our procurement team will want a placeholder SOW and an estimated cost range for a 6-month pilot — we don't need firm numbers, just a ballpark to start internal approval.
- We will loop in our security lead (Priya) on the call — she has a few SOC 2-specific questions.

Also, is there an option for a VPC/private deployment? We have regulatory controls that may push us that direction after pilot.

Thanks — confirming Tue Jun 8 14:00 PST. Send calendar invite and any prep docs.
